name: 10%, 1%, 50% and 25%
rule: Four easy percents: 10% is a tenth (divide by 10), 1% is a hundredth (divide by 100), 50% is half, and 25% is a quarter (halve, then halve again).
why: Percent means out of 100, so these are friendly pieces of any number. Knowing them lets you check a percent answer in your head, and build the harder ones.
